ticket.subject: Where can I download my Ledgerline receipts?
ticket.body: Hi, my accountant is asking for the receipts for my Ledgerline subscription for the last six months. Where do I find and download them? I would also like the company name on them to be updated. No rush at all, any time this week is fine. Thanks in advance for pointing me in the right direction.

note: Receipt download and billing details, no refund.
